Hard to see (B) difficult to see; (C) Poor to be seen; Hard to see Unseen. (D) Unseen. Bad-looking, bad-tempered. (E) The state of being invisible (Bhavadhana). Doddika - Look.
a: ရူ။၆ဝ၅။မောဂ်။ပဉ္စိကာ၊၅။၁၂၎။နီတိ၊သုတ္တ။၁၁၇၎။] (က)ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် သိမြင်အပ်သော၊ သိမြင်နိုင်ခဲသော၊ သက်ဝင်နိုင်ခဲသော။(ခ)ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် တွေ့မြင်အပ်သော၊ တွေ့မြင်နိုင်ခဲသော။(ဂ)ဆင်းရဲသဖြင့် ကြည့်အပ်သော၊ ကြည့်ရန်ခက်သော၊ မကြည့်နိုင်သော။(ဃ)မကောင်းသဖြင့် မြင်အပ်သော၊ အမြင်-ဆိုး-မကောင်း-သော၊ အကြည့်တန်-အရုပ်ဆိုး-သော။(င)သိမြင်နိုင်ခဲသည်၏ အဖြစ်(ဘာဝပ္ပဓာန်)။ ဒုဒ္ဒိက္ခ-ကြည့်။

[ဒု+ဒိန။(ဒုဒ္ဒိဏ-ပြာ,[du+dina.(duddiṇa-prā

,အဒ္ဓမာဂဓီ)] (က)ဖျက်ဆီးအပ်သော-နေ့-နေ့အခါ။(ခ)မိုးတိမ်တို့ဖြင့် ဖုံးလွှမ်းအပ်သော-နေ့-နေ့အခါ၊ မိုးအုံ့သော-နေ့-နေ့အခါ။ ဒုဒ္ဒိနီ-လည်းကြည့်။,
duddinna,ဒုဒ္ဒိန္န(တိ),[ဒု+ဒိန္န။(ဒုဒိဏ္ဏ-ပြာ)],[du+dinna.(dudiṇṇa-prā)],မကောင်းသဖြင့် ပေးအပ်သော၊ အပေးမမြောက်သော။,
duddinī,ဒုဒ္ဒိနီ(တိ),[ဒုဒ္ဒိန+ဤ],[duddina+ī],ဖျက်ဆီးအပ်သော နေ့ရှိသော။,
duddiṭṭha,ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌ(တိ),[ဒု+ဒိသ+တ။],[du+disa+ta.],မကောင်းသဖြင့်-မြင်အပ်-သိမြင်အပ်-သော။,
duddiṭṭharūpa,ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌရူပ(တိ),[ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌ+ရူပ],[duddiṭṭha+rūpa],ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌသဘာဝ-ကြည့်။,
duddiṭṭhasabhāva,ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌသဘာဝ(တိ),[ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌ+သဘာဝ],[duddiṭṭha+sabhāva],မကောင်းသဖြင့် မြင်အပ်သော သဘောရှိသော။ ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌသဘာဝ-ကြည့်။,
duddiṭṭhi,ဒုဒ္ဒိဋ္ဌိ(ထီ),[ဒု+ဒိဋ္ဌိ။],[du+diṭṭhi.],(၁)မကောင်းသောအယူ၊ ဖောက်ပြန်-မှားယွင်း-သော အယူ၊ အယူမှား၊ မိစ္ဆာအယူ။(တိ)(၂)မိစ္ဆာအယူရှိသော၊ သူ။,
duddohaḷa,ဒုဒ္ဒေါဟဠ(ပု),[ဒု+ဒေါဟဠ],[du+dohaḷa],မကောင်းသော ချင်ခြင်း။,
duddubha,ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ(ပု),[ဒုဒ္ဒု+ဘီ+အ],[duddu+bhī+a],ဒဒ္ဒုဘ-ဒုဒ်ဒုဒ်-ဒိုင်းဒိုင်း-ဟူသော မြည်သံ၊ ကြောက်စရာအသံ။,

(kā ~i kati diṭṭhiṭṭhānāni … kati ~iyo ti soḷasa ~iyo); Ap 480, 21 (kesesu chijjamānesu ~i chinnā samūlikā); Vibh 245, 27 (idhā ti imissā ~iyā imissā khantiyā … imasmiṃ satthu sāsane; Vibh-a 325, 12 : [sāsanaṃ] hi buddhena bhagavatā diṭṭhattā ~ī ti vuccati); 341, 11 (dasa kilesavatthūni lobho doso moho māno ~i vicikicchā …); 392,11 (katamā dasavatthukā antaggāhikā ~i); Kv 116, 20 (sabbaṃ atthī ti yā ~i sā ~i micchādiṭṭhī ti); Vism 19, 20 (kalyāṇamitto yaṃ nissāya … ~iṃ ujuṃ karoti); Paṭis-a 444, 17 (~iyā eva saṃsāre bandhanaṃ dasseti); Saddh 13; — ifc see akiriyā̆- ( sv kiriyā ), uccheda-, kudiṭṭhi, dvāsaṭṭḥi- ( sv dvā ), natthika-, niyatamicchā- ( sv niyacchati ), micchā-, sakkāya-, sammā- ( sv sammā 2 ), sassata-; — 2. right view; insight ; Vin IV 51, 28 (dhammā bahussutā honti … ~iyā suppaṭividdhā) = D III 267, 9 ; A III 349, 13 (tassa savanena pi akataṃ hoti bāhusaccena pi akataṃ hoti ~iyā pi appaṭividdhaṃ hoti); IV 98, 4* (taṃ damena samucchinde paññāviriyena ~iyā; Mp IV 49, 19 : magga-sammādiṭṭhiyā); Sn 471 (samāhito yo udatāri oghaṃ dhammaṃ ca ñāsi paramāya ~iyā; Pj II 409, 26 : sabbaññutañāṇena); Vibh 328, 26 (yā evarūpā anulomikā khanti ~i ruci muti pekkhā dhammanijjhānakhanti idaṃ vuccati saccānulomikaṃ ñāṇaṃ); — 3. sight; the eye ; Sadd 332, 30* (… nettaṃ locanaṃ ~i …); 548, 18 (cakkhu hi passanti etāyā ti ~ī ti vuccati); — °’ ânusaya , m. , an inherent tendency to (false) views; persistent (wrong) views ; D III 254, 4 ; M I 110, 1 ; Paṭis I 195, 34 ; Paṭis-a 440, 6 (diṭṭhi yeva thāmagataṭṭhena anusayo ti ~o); — °’- anta , m. [diṭṭhanta 2 ; prob. diṭṭhi + anta 1 , but cf Sadd 853, 26 : diṭṭhā antaṃ patto ti diṭṭhippatto], insight; the aim of insight ; Vism 660, 5 (~aṃ patto ti diṭṭhipatto, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee diṭṭhappatto) = Sv 890, 5 ≠ Mp II 148, 1 (diṭṭhippatto ti ~aṃ patto) quoting Paṭis II 52, 8 : (eds diṭṭhattā patto ti diṭṭhippatto); — °’- āvikamma , n. , revealing one’s opinion; voicing one’s dissent ; Vin V 183, 24 ; 187, 7 foll. (Sp 1374, 26 : ~ā ti diṭṭhīnaṃ āvikammānaṃ laddhipakāsanāni, āpattidesanāsaṅkhātānaṃ vinayakammānaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Sv 1043, 12 (na m’ etaṃ khamatī ti evaṃ ~aṃ akatvā, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); — °- ugghāṭana , n. [diṭṭhi + ugghāṭana 2 ], the removal of (wrong) views ; Vism 627, 21 foll. ; — °’- upādāna , °’- ûpādāna , n. , the grasping of views; the fuel that is (false) views ; D II 58, 1 ; Vibh 375, 7 ; Vism 569, 7 foll. ; — °- gata , n. , a (false) view, a theory ; Vin IV 134, 1 (Ariṭṭhassa nāma bhikkhuno … evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ ~aṃ uppannaṃ hoti); M I 485, 28 (sassato loko ti kho Vaccha ~aṃ etaṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ …); S I 135, 18* ; A V 72, 24 (paṭibalo hoti uppannaṃ ~aṃ dhammato vivecetuṃ); Sn 834 (manasā ~āni cintayanto); 836 (diṭṭhīgataṃ … vadesi kīdisaṃ, Se so, mc; Be, Ee ~aṃ; Ce diṭṭhiggataṃ); Paṭis I 138, 28 ; Sp 53, 3 (sakāni sakāni ~āni ayaṃ dhammo ayaṃ vinayo ti dīpenti); As 214, 16 foll. (diṭṭhiyo eva ~āni … dvāsaṭṭhiyā vā diṭṭhīnaṃ antogadhattā diṭṭhīsu gatānī ti pi ~āni diṭṭhiyā vā gataṃ etesan ti pi ~āni); — °- gatika , m ( fn ). [ from diṭṭhigata], one holding a (false) view or theory ; Ja II 54, 11´ (~-ttā); V 241, 15´ (ete pañca ~ā); Nidd I 102, 7 (sant’ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ~ā, te dvāsaṭṭhiyā °-gatānaṃ aññataraṃ °-gataṃ … gahetvā … sakāya sakāya diṭṭhiyā vasanti); Ud-a 358, 23 (yadā pana sammāsambuddhā loke uppajjanti tadā ~ā na sujjhanti na sobhanti); Pj II 553, 34 (ete ca ~e sassatucchedadiṭṭhiyo nissitā ti ñatvā); — ifc see nānā-; — °- carita , m ( fn )., (one) with a disposition to theories ; Nett 109, 26 ; Vism 578, 25 (~ānaṃ hi avijjā … saṃsāranāyikā); Sv 754, 10 ; — °- tassanā , f. , trembling, agitation, because of one’s theories ; Sv 111, 14 ; — °- dhammika in Ee at Nidd I 73, 20 and 73, 22 is wr for diṭṭhadhammika qv sv √dis 2 ; — °- nijjhānakkhanti , f. , readiness to accept a view after reflection; a view preferred after reflection ;? M II 171, 19 foll. (~i ce pi … purisassa hoti evaṃ me ~ī ti iti vadaṃ saccaṃ anurakkhati); S II 115, 25 (aññatra ~iyā; Spk II 122, 28 : aparassa cintayato ekā diṭṭhi uppajjati yā yassa hi kāraṇaṃ nijjhāyantassa khamati so atth’ etan ti ~iyā gaṇhāti); Nidd I 360, 23 (sakkhidhamman ti na itihītihaṃ … na ~iyā, sāmaṃ sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ; Nidd-a I 388, 9 : ~iyā ti amhākaṃ nijjhāyitvā khamitvā gahitadiṭṭhiyā saddhiṃ sametī ti); — °- nipāta , m. , a look, a glance ; — ifc see mudusiniddha-; — °- patta , m ( fn )., (one) who has achieved insight; who has achieved ( nibbāna ) through insight ; D III 105, 28 (satt’ ime bhante puggalā … kāyasakkhi ~o saddhāvimutto …); Paṭis II 52, 6 (paññindriyassa adhimattattā ~o hoti; Paṭis-a 563, 18 foll. : ~o ti diṭṭhattā patto ti … paññindriyena paṭhamaṃ nibbānassa diṭṭhattā pacchā … nibbānaṃ patto ti ~o, paññindriyasaṅkhātāya diṭṭhiyā nibbānaṃ patto ti vuttaṃ hoti); Nett 190, 3 (~ena, Be, Ce so; Ee diṭṭha-); Mil 102, 27 (sotāpannā pihitāpāyā ~ā viññātasatthusāsanā); Vism 663, 8 (~ā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee diṭṭha-); Sadd 853, 26 (diṭṭhā antaṃ patto ti ~o, paññācakkhunā disvā saṃsārassa antaṃ nibbānaṃ patto adhigato ti attho); 854, 4 (diṭṭhiṃ patto diṭṭhiyā vā patto ~o); — neg. adiṭṭhipatta, mfn. , Spk I 215, 23 ; — °- maṇḍala , n. , the pupil of the eye ; Paṭis-a 78, 11 = As 307, 15 quoted Sadd 548, 21 ; — °- yāyaka , °- yā , mfn. , following views ; Sn 846 (na vedagū °-yāyako, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se °-yā; Nidd I 205, 23 : so diṭṭhiyā na yāyati; Pj II 547, 20 foll. : catumaggavedagū mādiso °-yāyako na hoti, diṭṭhiyā gacchanto vā taṃ sārato paccento vā na hoti … yāyatī ti yāyako, karaṇavacanena diṭṭhiyā yātī ti °-yāyako upayogatthe sāmivacanena diṭṭhiyā yātī ti pi °-yāyako, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee yātī ti yā tato … diṭṭhiyā yātī ti pi °-yā … diṭṭhiṃ yātī ti pi °-yā); — adiṭṭhi , f. , (what is) not a view; lack of view or belief ; Sn 839 (~iyā; Pj II 545, 26 : dasavatthukaṃ sammādiṭṭhiṃ vinā); Paṭis-a 444, 18 (diṭṭhibhūtāni pi saṃyojanāni atthi ~-bhūtāni pi); — duddiṭṭhi , f. and mfn. , 1. ( f. ) a bad or false view ; Sp 511, 5 (mahājanaṃ ~iṃ micchādiṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāpesi); Ps III 441, 6 (sā va nesaṃ diṭṭhi ~ī ti); — 2. ( or duddiṭṭhi[n]), mfn. , whose views are bad or false ; Ud 73, 13* (~ī na dukkhā pamuccare; Ud-a 359, 1 : takkikā hi ayāthāvaladdhikatāya ~ī micchābhiniviṭṭhadiṭṭhikā viparītadassanā, Ce, Se so; Ee ~i; Be ~ino); Dhp 339 (vāhā vahanti ~iṃ saṅkappā rāganissitā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee duddiṭṭham; ≠ Th 760: kuddiṭṭhiṃ); — niddiṭṭhi , mfn. , without views or theories ; Paṭis I 80, 4 (~i caratī ti viññāṇacariyā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nidiṭṭhi); — sadiṭṭhi , mfn. , with views or theories ; Nidd I 86, 2 ; Paṭis I 81, 31 (~i caratī ti aññāṇacariyā); — see also akiriyā̆diṭṭhika ( sv kiriyā ), aññadiṭṭhika ( sv añña 2 ), atidiṭṭhiyā, āgamanadiṭṭhika, ucchedadiṭṭhika, evaṃdiṭṭhika, kiṃdiṭṭhika ( sv ka 3 ), taṃdiṭṭhika ( sv ta[d] ), thāmagatadiṭṭhika ( sv thāma ), natthikadiṭṭhika, nānā-diṭṭhika ( sv nānā ), niyatamicchādiṭṭhika ( sv niyacchati ), micchādiṭṭhika, vimissadiṭṭhika, sadiṭṭhika, sammā-diṭṭhika ( sv sammā 2 ), sassatadiṭṭhika.
NCP: mfn. | duddi.t.thi whose views are bad or false.

duddubha.p: [Duddu+bhī+a] (pu) Google Translate The sound of Dadduba-Doddod-Shield. Sounds scary.

B:

ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ（ပု）
[duddu+bhī+a]
[ဒုဒ္ဒု+ဘီ+အ]
K:
duddubha：ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ（ပု）
[ဒုဒ္ဒု+ဘီ+အ]
ဒဒ္ဒုဘ-ဒုဒ်ဒုဒ်-ဒိုင်းဒိုင်း-ဟူသော မြည်သံ၊ ကြောက်စရာအသံ။
R:
duddubha：ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ （ပ）
ဒဒ်ဒဒ်မြည်သံ။
DOP: daddabha, daddubha duddubha [ onomat. ?], a heavy noise, “thud” ; Ja III 76, 25 (addhā tassa tālapaṇṇassa upari beluvapakkaṃ patitvā daddabhaṃ akāsi, Ee so; Be daddubhāyanasaddaṃ akāsi; Ce daddabhāyanasaddaṃ; Se daddhabhāyanasaddaṃ); 77, 12´ (daddabhā ti saddaṃ karoti, Ce, Ee so; Se daddhabhā ti; Be daddubhasaddaṃ karoti); 77, 24* (beluvaṃ patitaṃ sutvā daddabhan ti saso javi, Ce so; Be daddubhan ti; Ee dabhakkan ti; Se daddhabhan ti; 78, 4´ : evaṃ saddaṃ kurumānaṃ) quoted Ps II 93, 18* ( Be, Se duddubhan ti; Ce, Ee dabhakkan ti); Sadd 587, 14 (saddo daddubha iti ācarati daddubhāyati); — see also daddabhāyati.

duddubhāyati.p: [Duddubha+āya+ti] (kri) Google Translate Niti, Dha. 372.] He makes a sound: I made a terrible noise.

B:
duddubhāyati：duddubhāyati（kri）
ဒုဒ္ဒုဘာယတိ（ကြိ）
[duddubha+āya+ti．nīti，dhā.372.]
[ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ+အာယ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ဓာ။၃၇၂။]
K:
duddubhāyati：ဒုဒ္ဒုဘာယတိ（ကြိ）
[ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ+အာယ+တိ။ နီတိ၊ဓာ။၃၇၂။]
ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ-ဒုဒ်ဒုဒ်-ဒိုင်းဒိုင်း-ဟူသော အသံကို ပြု၏၊ ကြောက်စရာအသံကို ပြု၏။
R:
duddubhāyati：ဒုဒ္ဒုဘာယတိ （နာ）
ဒဒ်ဒဒ်မြည်၏။ဒုဒ္ဒုဘ
DOP: daddabhāyati, daddubhāyati duddubhāyati pr. 3 sg. [ denom. from daddabha, daddubha], there is a heavy noise; something goes “thud” ; Ja III 77, 10* (daddabhāyati bhaddan ti yasmiṃ dese vasām’ ahaṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be daddubhāyati; Se daddhabhāyati; 77, 12´ : daddabhāyatī ti daddabhā ti saddaṃ karoti, Ce, Ee so; Be daddubhāyatī ti daddubhasaddaṃ karoti; Se daddhabhāyatī ti daddhabhā ti saddaṃ karoti) quoted Ps II 93, 7* ( Ce, Ee so; Be, Se duddubhāyati); Sadd 587, 14 (saddo daddubha iti ācarati daddubhāyati); — pp daddabhāyita, ( mf ) n. , thudding; a thud ; Mp II 277, 14 (paṭhaviyaṃ patitassa beluvapakkassa daddabhāyita-saddaṃ sutvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se daddahāyita-).

duddasika duddassika mfn. [du(s) + dasika 2 ; cf S. durdarśa, durdṛśīka], disagreeable to the sight; of unpleasing appearance, ugly ; Vin II 90, 23 (ekacco dubbaṇṇo hoti ~o okoṭimako, Ce so; Be, Ee, Se duddassiko) ≠ M III 169, 31 = S I 94, 2 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se duddassiko; Spk I 162, 30 : vijātamātuyā pi amanāpa-dassano); S II 279, 18 (passatha … etaṃ bhikkhuṃ āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ ~aṃ okoṭimakaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee duddassikaṃ) ≠ Ud 76, 15 ( Be, Ce so; Ee, Se duddassikaṃ); Ja IV 489, 19 (bheravasadde migapakkhī ~e amanusse ca paṭikkamāpetva); Vism 108, 14 (dubbaṇṇā ~ā kiliṭṭhavasanā duggandhā, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se duddassikā).
